Most recent paper related to non-commutative geometry submitted by an author with the first name John (arXiv advanced search: All fields "non-commutative geometry" AND Author(s) John*, ordered by Announcement date newest first): arXiv:1908.06796

Title: Finite spectral triples for the fuzzy torus

Abstract: We classify all finite spectral triples for the fuzzy torus algebra. We show that each such triple has a direct sum decomposition into standard components, and that the Dirac operator can be written as a sum of twisted partial derivatives. We also discuss the relationship between these finite spectral triples and the spectral triples for the non-commutative torus, showing that the fuzzy torus spectral triples arise as finite-dimensional approximations of the non-commutative torus spectral triples in a precise sense related to non-commutative geometry.
